package.name: marine_sonar_widgets
package.description: Shared Qt/OpenGL sonar-display widgets (scrolling backscatter waterfall, water-column echogram) and a framework-agnostic target-marking core for the UNH marine autonomy stack. One implementation feeds both the live rqt_operator_tools plugins and the offline marine_perception_tools viewer, and both produce the same marine_interfaces/msg/Contact when an analyst marks a target. No rqt / rclcpp / rosbag2 dependency.
